requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-3734-4231-4452--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Rukarumel, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Phyrexian Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Rukarumel, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

413-856-5776-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 4, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

512-1355-4091.easyPrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-1355-4091.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
512-1355-4091.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Sanctum Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1355-4091.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Sanctum Weaver's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

147-653-4050.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-653-4050.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1430-1619-1974.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1430-1619-1974.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Mirror Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1430-1619-1974.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

240-2034-4068-5470.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
240-2034-4068-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

6575-6685-7296.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-2921-7215.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gnarlbark Elm.
When Gnarlbark Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

2034-2804-3490-4369.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-2804-3490-4369.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Witty Roastmaster triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Witty Roastmaster triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Witty Roastmaster triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

328-2173-2292-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2173-2292-5220.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1274-3490-4659-6823.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4659-6823.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

435-2921-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auratog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

745-1912-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry has a power of at least 2.
745-1912-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

190-389-6035-6126.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 5 or less.
190-389-6035-6126.description:
Cast Courageous Resolve by paying {2}{W}.
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Courageous Resolve.
Cast Merciless Eviction by paying its mana cost, exiling all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

2440-2617-4613-5917.notablePrerequisites:
Midnight Guard has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
2440-2617-4613-5917.description:
Activate Midnight Guard using The Jolly Balloon Man's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of another nonlegendary creature you control that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Midnight Guard and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
Repeat.

640-3247-3327-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least three.
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
640-3247-3327-4871.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Razaketh by paying two life and sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Pitiless Plunderer and Dross Harvester's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Razaketh ability, causing you to search your library for a card and put it into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2034-2775-4365.description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Saproling tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Slimefoot triggers twice, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

2034-2308-3025.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-3025.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

238-2857-4412-5147.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, causing Gerrard to be returned from your graveyard to the battlefield the next time it dies this turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Gerrard and Adarkar Valkyrie.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Gerrard trigger.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger, returning all artifact and creature cards that were put into your graveyard this turn from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 2 damage to any target(s).
Repeat.
